name: jev-semaphore
description: Jev Semaphore for Claude Code: Jev / Kev model routing for subagents, with a live allocation pane, agent graph and context-exchange band

backend.title: Routing backend
backend.description: typesafe = hosted Jev (api.typesafe.ai), openrouter = hosted Jev through OpenRouter, kev-local = your own Kev server, off = heuristic routing only

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Hosted Jev key, settable only via `claude plugin configure` on an installed plugin; otherwise paste it in /jev-semaphore setup (macOS Keychain) or use the 1Password reference below

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter key, settable only via `claude plugin configure` on an installed plugin; otherwise paste it in /jev-semaphore setup (macOS Keychain) or use the 1Password reference below

typesafeKeyRef.title: TypeSafe key · 1Password ref
typesafeKeyRef.description: Optional op:// reference (e.g. op://Private/TypeSafe/credential), read with the op CLI at session start; nothing secret is stored

openrouterKeyRef.title: OpenRouter key · 1Password ref
openrouterKeyRef.description: Optional op:// reference (e.g. op://Private/OpenRouter/credential), read with the op CLI at session start

kevUrl.title: Kev server URL
kevUrl.description: Base URL of a local Kev server

kevRepoPath.title: Kev checkout
kevRepoPath.description: Where the kev repository is (or will be) cloned; ~ is your home folder

kevModel.title: Kev model size
kevModel.description: Which Kev checkpoint the managed server runs

kevAutostart.title: Start Kev with the session
kevAutostart.description: When the backend is kev-local, start the managed Kev server if it is not running

routingMode.title: Routing mode
routingMode.description: auto applies Jev's pick to each subagent, recommend only shows it, off disables routing

downgradeFloor.title: Downgrade confidence floor
downgradeFloor.description: Jev must be at least this sure (0-1) before a role moves to a cheaper model

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Soft per-session spend cap shown as a gauge; 0 turns it off

openrouterModels.title: OpenRouter worker models
openrouterModels.description: Comma-separated OpenRouter model slugs offered as cheap workers
